Definition: perhaps from G3817; a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God):--child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man.
BiblicalUsage: Pais is the child, the boy or girl, and by extension the servant — especially the servant of God. The centurion's servant lies sick of the palsy, the child Jesus tarries behind in Jerusalem, Isaiah's servant is quoted of Christ, Behold my servant, whom I have chosen, and the church prays of God's holy child Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe pais holds two truths together. The child who needs care and the servant who gives it, and Christ is both — the Child of God and the Servant of the LORD.
